# TradeScale Plus: AI-powered websites. We turn old, static websites into interactive ones.

> TradeScale Plus turns old, static websites into interactive, AI-powered ones, and gives the business the buyer data its website never captured. Two lines of code put the Website Agent inside a car dealer's or estate agent's own website, where it answers buyers from the business's own stock and pages, drives the stock list to the cars a buyer describes in their own words, works out finance at the dealer's own rate, books test drives and viewings, and emails every lead to the business with the car or home named. We set it up and run it.

TradeScale Plus is Trade Scale Plus Ltd, registered in England and Wales, company number 17142290. It was founded by Ash Evans, who spent 15 years in the motor trade at Citroen, Land Rover and Honda dealers and used car sites, salesman then sales manager. Richard Beagle works with car dealers, estate agencies and web providers to get the Website Agent live.

## 01 The interactive website

- **The bar, on the home page and stock list.** A buyer types what they want in their own words ("automatic SUV under £20k") and the website's own stock list shows exactly those cars, never a sold or reserved one. A question gets its answer right there in the bar. It also shows "Carry on where you left off" (the last cars the buyer looked at, still for sale), the newest arrivals and up to three cars the dealer features from the dashboard.
- **The panel, on every car page,** under the photos and the price, at one fixed size: the buyer's monthly at the dealer's own APR, worked out to the penny with the representative example; a side by side with a car they saved or looked at; part-exchange details (registration and mileage) for the team, with no price given; a test drive on one of the next five days the dealer is open, inside opening hours, confirmed by the team; and their saved cars. Questions about the car are answered from its own listing, day and night.
- **On a phone** the bar stacks under the site's search and the panel sits after the site's own buttons, in one column, with the question box always in reach.
- **For estate agents (UK and Dubai):** the bar counts the agency's homes as the visitor types and opens the agency's own search page for exactly those; the panel on every listing answers from the listing, books viewings as a request for the listing's consultant to confirm, compares homes like it, and keeps the visitor's saved homes.

## 02 Your leads

Every enquiry and test drive request is emailed the moment it is made, with the car named, the buyer's name and number or email and what they want; a reply goes straight to the buyer. Keen buyers are marked HOT. A test drive comes with Confirm this time: once pressed, a buyer who gave their email gets their confirmation and a reminder the day before. Estate agency leads go to the listing's own consultant when we have their address.

## 03 The data we provide

Only what the Website Agent records on the business's own website: every conversation, kept and searchable; what buyers searched for in the chat and the top prices they gave; the searches nothing in stock fitted (a buying list); the most viewed cars; cars asked about with nobody leaving their details; where buyers came from, with AI tools like ChatGPT counted apart; the questions the adverts could not answer; the Stock Health Check on each car's advert; and which AI tools read the stock. Only totals of visits are kept: nobody is identified.

## 04 Your dashboard

The dealer dashboard opens on the results (leads, viewings and test drives booked, leads while the dealer was shut) and who to ring first, with a diary, the leads, every conversation, the stock and the data above. Estate agencies get a team page: a manager sees the whole team, each consultant opens on their own day.

## 05 Set up and run by us

1. Two lines of code, added by the web company, or with one click from the business in its own Google Tag Manager.
2. We set it up: colours, logo, opening hours, finance.
3. It reads the website every day: new stock in, sold stock out, prices as the business sets them.
4. We look after it: every answer is checked in code before a buyer sees it.
5. AI can read the stock: a plain page for tools like ChatGPT, with every car or home on it and a search.

## The AI door

Some pages are drawn by JavaScript, which ChatGPT cannot normally read. On 1 November 2026 we put our two install lines on a test page built that way. ChatGPT found the live stock on its own, with no setup by the user. Asked "I need a 7 seater under 18,000", it gave all five correct cars and prices, and a follow-up about electric cars returned all three correct. We saw it in our server logs. This was one test, on a test page we built. It is not a client result and it is not a promise: no one can promise what an AI will recommend. https://tradescaleplus.com/ai-door
